topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well, now, I heard word of your friend's doings. It's a strange thing, isn’t it, to find out the one you’ve shared your bread with, the one you thought was as honest as the sun rising, wasn’t telling the whole truth. It’s like finding a fox in the henhouse, when you least expect it. I reckon it does shake the ground under your feet. Makes you wonder what else might be hiding beneath the soil, doesn’t it? But mayhaps there’s a reason, a good reason, that we don’t see straight away. Hope it’s just a misunderstanding, and the rain will clear the air come morning.
